name: GNU grep
blurb: Current GNU grep, replacing a GNV grep that is many releases behind. Includes grep -P with PCRE2 linked in, so the kit is self-contained.

name: GNU sed
blurb: The GNU stream editor, built natively with VSI C and tested against upstream's own suite.

name: GNU awk
blurb: gawk, built with the OpenVMS port that ships inside every gawk release, wrapped in our signed-tarball tooling and PCSI kits.
try: $ gawk "{ n += $2 } END { print n }" SIZES.DAT

name: curl
blurb: Current curl with TLS from VSI's OpenSSL 3 kit and zlib linked in. Installs as VMSCURL, so it can sit alongside VSI's own CURL kit.

name: GNU Wget
blurb: GNU Wget with HTTPS through VSI's OpenSSL 3 kit and a current CA bundle. It writes downloads as stream files, whatever the old version's record format was.

name: GNU m4
blurb: The GNU macro processor. syscmd and esyscmd run DCL commands through LIB$SPAWN. Bison runs m4 to generate its parsers.

name: GNU Bison
blurb: The GNU parser generator. It runs GNU m4 for OpenVMS to generate its parsers, so the kit requires the M4 kit.

name: PCRE2
blurb: Perl-compatible regular expressions (8-bit, Unicode) as an object library and headers under PCRE2$ROOT. It provides grep -P.

name: zlib
blurb: The zlib compression library as an object library and headers under ZLIB$ROOT. It provides compressed transfers in curl and Wget.
